title: Barbie Skipper Babysitters Inc. Playset with Brunette Doll
writeup: The Barbie Skipper Babysitters Inc. playset with the brunette Skipper doll is back in stock at $10. It includes a toddler doll, a high chair and eight accessories for babysitting play. Walmart sells the same set at $19.99, so this price is about 49 percent lower, and it was seen at this price on Nov 27 at 10:09 AM ET.
